Units The potency of secretin may be expressed as Crick-Harper- Raper (CHR) units based on the pancreatic secretion in cats or as clinical units, the value of which was amended in the 1960s. One clinical unit is considered to be approximately equivalent to 4 CHR units. One clinical unit is equivalent to 200 nanograms of a purified synthetic preparation of secretin.
